description:
infection: BioGears' acute inflammatory response (pathogens, immune cells, cytokines, nitric oxide, tissue integrity) and the clinical signs of sepsis; setpoint: infection severity (one-way).
nutrition: Meals and drinks at scheduled times (nutrition_schedule); readings: stomach contents and the body's water balance.
lymph: Lymph formation (13 tissue valves), the lymph pool, and its return to the vena cava. BioGears 8.2.0 has no compartment links for lymph, so these are circuit reads (pybiogears P5).
tissue_fluid: Per-tissue extracellular/intracellular volumes, capillary filtration, endothelial resistance, plasma and interstitial oncotic pressures, interstitial pressure and albumin; whole-body fluid totals.
cardiovascular: Hemodynamics plus pressure, volume and flows of 42 vascular compartments (central, cerebral, renal, peripheral); setpoints: a hemorrhage and an IV infusion.
treatment: Timed IV treatment (treatment_schedule): compound boluses and infusions (saline, antibiotics) and substance infusions; setpoint: a vasopressor infusion rate; readings: antibiotic activity and the treatment_readouts substances' concentrations.

irreversible_state.description: True once BioGears reports an irreversible state; the engine is not advanced after that.

summary: BioGears 8.2.0 modules: infection, nutrition, lymph, tissue_fluid, cardiovascular, treatment
